title: Baby Girl Renie-Sue on Lawn, 1960 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A vintage black and white square snapshot stamped 'JUN 60' on the right border, capturing a baby girl named Renie-Sue sitting outdoors on a blanket placed upon a grassy backyard lawn. She is wearing a sun bonnet and holding a small toy ball. The background shows a suburban backyard bordered by a wooden fence, young trees, and a cinder block wall.
